page.title: Jobs
page.description: Work captured from calls or logged by your team — scheduled, delivered, and invoiced.

active.title: No active jobs
active.description: Work your agent captures on calls, or that you log, shows up here.

unscheduled.title: Nothing to schedule
unscheduled.description: Every open job has a booked visit. New work lands here first.

completed.title: No completed jobs yet
completed.description: Jobs you finish land here, ready to invoice.

all.title: No jobs yet
all.description: Log your first job, or let your agent capture them from calls.

noMatch.title: No jobs match
noMatch.description: Try a different search or clear some filters.

toSchedule.label: To schedule
toSchedule.highPriority: {count, plural, one {# high-priority job in play} other {# high-priority jobs in play}}

visitsToday.label: Visits today
visitsToday.inProgress: {count, plural, one {# job in progress} other {# jobs in progress}}
visitsToday.bookedAhead: {count, plural, one {# visit booked ahead} other {# visits booked ahead}}

activeWork.label: Active work
activeWork.across: {count, plural, one {Across # active job} other {Across # active jobs}}

completedThisMonth.label: Completed this month
completedThisMonth.allTime: {count, plural, one {# job completed all time} other {# jobs completed all time}}

row.capturedFromCall: Captured from a call {date} — needs a time

filters.searchLabel: Search jobs by title or contact name

form.createDescription: Log a piece of work to schedule and deliver. Price it up with line items after.
form.editDescription: Update the details — status and times move from the job's actions.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: The work to be done, e.g. Hot water system replacement
form.estimatedMinutesHint: How long the visit takes — sets the booked window. Blank = your module default.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Scope of the work, materials, access notes… (optional)

noSelection.title: No job selected
noSelection.description: Select a job to see its details and history.

notFound.title: Job not found
notFound.description: This job doesn't exist or was removed.

lineItems.title: Line items
lineItems.dialogDescription: Labour and materials for this job. VAT is applied when it's invoiced.
lineItems.descriptionPlaceholder: What will be done or supplied
lineItems.emptyFromCall: No line items yet — this job came in from a call. Price it up before invoicing.
lineItems.empty: No line items yet — add labour and materials to price the job.

photos.title: Photos & files
photos.empty: No photos yet — site shots and paperwork live here with the job.
photos.deleteDescription: The file is removed from this job permanently.

activity.title: Activity
activity.notePlaceholder: Add a note — site access, parts ordered, what was done…
activity.noteLabel: Add a note to this job
activity.empty: Nothing yet — notes, bookings, and status changes will show up here.

schedule.scheduleDescription: Book the visit — the customer gets a confirmation email.
schedule.rescheduleDescription: Pick a new visit time — the customer gets the update by email.
schedule.keepsLength: The visit keeps its current length.
schedule.bookedFor: {minutes, plural, one {The visit is booked for # minute.} other {The visit is booked for # minutes.}}
schedule.bookedForDefault: {minutes, plural, one {The visit is booked for # minute (your module default).} other {The visit is booked for # minutes (your module default).}}

cancel.title: Cancel {reference}?
cancel.descriptionBooked: The booked visit is called off and the customer gets a cancellation email.
cancel.descriptionOpen: The job is closed as canceled — it can be reopened later.
cancel.reasonHint: Kept on the job — and quoted in the customer email.

delete.title: Delete {reference}?
delete.description: “{title}” and its timeline disappear from the portal. A booked visit stops blocking the schedule. Invoices already raised from it are kept.

reopen.title: Reopen {reference}?
reopen.description: The job goes back to open and unscheduled — any previous booking stays cleared, so schedule a fresh visit when you're ready. Its history is kept.

invoice.title: Invoice {reference}?
invoice.descriptionWithAmount: Drafts an invoice for {amount} (plus tax) copying the job's line items, ready to review and send to {customer}. A job is invoiced once.
invoice.description: Drafts an invoice copying the job's line items, ready to review and send to {customer}. A job is invoiced once.

toasts.rescheduled: {reference} rescheduled — the customer will be emailed
toasts.booked: {reference} booked in — the customer will be emailed
toasts.reopened: {reference} reopened — book a new time when ready
toasts.fileTooLarge: That file is over 10 MB — resize it and try again.
